idea.title: ToolForge — Generate MCP tools from OpenAPI specs automatically

plan.tagline: Turn any OpenAPI spec into ready-to-use MCP tools in seconds
plan.problem: Indie hackers and small dev teams waste hours manually converting OpenAPI specs into MCP tooling instead of building their core product
plan.solution: Parse OpenAPI specs, auto-generate Python MCP tool files with proper typing, CLI integration, and offline demo mode—all with zero external dependencies
plan.target_market: Solo Python developers and small teams shipping AI agents who need fast MCP tool integration without heavy frameworks
mvp_features: Parse OpenAPI 3.0 specs to MCP tools
Generate typed Python CLI tools with argparse
Offline --demo mode with hardcoded weather API mock

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: sqlite schema for tool registry + add/list commands with OpenAPI parsing

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: generate MCP tool files from specs + basic error handling

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: --demo mode with hardcoded weather data + CLI polish

plan.demo_script: Run `openapi-forge --demo` to generate 3 mock MCP tools (weather, stock, translate) from hardcoded specs, list them with `openapi-forge list`, and inspect generated Python files in ./tools/
plan.phuket_angle: Thai travel agencies could auto-generate MCP tools from their booking API specs to integrate with AI agents for instant hotel/flight queries without custom backend work
